name: ViQuAE: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
description: ViQuAE is a visual question answering benchmark focused on named entity reasoning grounded in information retrieval. Consisting of 3,697 questions grounded in Wikimedia images and textual knowledge from Wikipedia, it requires models to retrieve external documents to recognize entities, understand multimodal contexts, and answer entity-centric queries.

verification.notes: Verified against SIGIR 2022 publication (DOI: 10.1145/3477495.3531735) and official GitHub repository (PaulLerner/ViQuAE). 3,697 questions partitioned into 1,190 train, 1,250 validation, and 1,257 test questions.
